answer: A sonnet has fourteen lines and no understudy. Each epoch, 28 timber stages open; a claim locks 75 POA, +30 per extra identity from one root, so ten linked fakes lock 2,100 POA. The claimant performs its sonnet live in one 20-minute window: fourteen lines seeded by the last block and the key, heard by three strangers on a trellis, each hearing at most two. One operator voices two sonnets at most: ten fakes need five voices, 140 lines, thirty hearings. A missed line burns 20 POA; a replayed line burns both bonds. Line times are checked against roots: one voice, ten sonnets, one identity.
